page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.6xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, delivering 24 vCPUs across 12 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled. The system includes 48.0 GB of memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware cache provisions include 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a 35 MB L3 cache. Network performance features a baseline throughput of 4 Gbps. The instance provides no bundled local storage and includes zero GPUs.

Benchmark results demonstrate consistent mid-tier multi-threaded performance alongside lower single-core throughput. The instance recorded 17,645.39 on stress-ng multi-core tests, a PassMark CPU score of 18,444.17, and a Geekbench multi-core score of 7,148.0, placing it in the average tier. Conversely, single-threaded metrics reflect the older processor architecture, showing 945.0 in Geekbench single-core and 1,108.08 in stress-ng single-core tests. Compression testing similarly shows 19.08 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip compression, ranking in the lower tiers, while multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 83.08 GB/sec.

Memory bandwidth benchmarks show 982.55 GB/sec for small cached reads, tapering to 90.83 GB/sec on large uncached blocks and 52.97 GB/sec for uncached writes. Operational benchmarks place the instance squarely in the middle tier for server tasks, achieving 16.86 million operations per second in Redis SET tests, 10.88 GB/sec in static web serving, and a PassMark database operations score of 6,463.52. Small model LLM prompt processing achieves 1,197.19 tokens per second, but falls to 10.34 tokens per second during medium model text generation.

The primary architectural tradeoff is the balance between parallel core capacity and modest per-core throughput. With 24 dedicated vCPUs, the instance handles concurrent parallel workloads effectively, but applications dependent on fast single-threaded execution will see limitations. Because the instance contains no local disks or hardware accelerators, external storage must be provisioned. It is appropriately suited for multi-threaded batch jobs, software compilation, medium-scale web serving tiers, and parallel data transformations.
